def execute_mind_body_switch_technique_naruto(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Yamanaka users project consciousness into another person's body, leaving their own vulnerable.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    assert is_valid_possession_target(target)
    save_original_controller_and_actor_body(actor,target)
    if possession_resistance_passes(target): transfer_controller(actor,target)
    keep_original_body_in_defined_vulnerable_state(actor)
    on_exit: restore_both_controllers_and_clear_links()
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
